content:
Items available:

Cash: 100 gold per player. 
Players playing children consume 1/2 what an adult uses. But cannot help with other activities until at least one adult is dead. Children roll at disadvantage for hunting and have other unfortunate capabilities.  


Compass: 25 Gold. (+2 to navigation to help prevent you from getting lost or +1 to help you find the trail again once you become lost.)


Oxen: 50 gold per (consumes 25 pounds of food per day unless eating grass, Maximum 4) 

Clothes: 10 gold per set. (Help prevent death from exposure)

Clean water: 1 gold per 2 gallons, maximum carry capacity 150 gallons.  (each player consumes 1 gallon per day. Oxen drink 1d27+3 gallons per day.)

Medicine: 50 gold per tonic. (cures 1 disease)

Crutch/sling: 20 Gold. (removes some of the penalties for having an injured member.

200 lbs of food: 200 gold maximum 400 pounds. (Chads consume 5 pounds each per day. Oxen eat 1d20+30 per day. Food has a chance of spoiling every day.)

100 bullets: 50 gold per ammo box (Used to Hunt) spending bullets per hunt makes it more likely to kill something. These can also be used to fend off wild animal attacks.

Wagon tongue: 350  gold (Wagon tongues take 1 day to repair with this part or 3 days to repair with out it.)

Wagon wheel: 150 gold (wagon wheels take 1 day to repair with this part or 2 days to repair with out it.)
